_comment: Pre-route netlist-level STA of the committed mesh netlist (issue #96). DEF-free: klt sta links the structural netlist against liberty and times it on clock_port/clock_period_ns alone, with no placement, routing or CTS, so the response labels itself geometry_source netlist_estimate. Run by layout/mesh/run.sh --sta, which gates on layout/mesh/check.sh so the report always describes the committed netlist. Not post-route STA and not item-5 evidence (issue #29).
